title: emc2 change rejection
description: Sent by the object store to the requester (not published on objects.changed) when it does not apply a change request. A change request is answered by exactly one change event or one change rejection, correlated by requestId. Data model 1.9.0 (PDA), see model/README.md.

code.description: Why the request was rejected. VALIDATION_FAILED: the request breaks the schema or a rule in model/README.md. ENTITY_NOT_FOUND: update or delete of an entity that does not exist. ENTITY_EXISTS: create with an id already in use. EXTERNAL_REF_EXISTS: create with an externalRef that another object has (model rule 16). LAYER_NOT_FOUND: the object's layerId refers to no layer. LAYER_NOT_EMPTY: delete of a layer that still has objects. PERMISSION_DENIED: the user or plugin may not do this. LAYER_LOCKED (data model 1.3.0, ADR-0042): a user's change to a locked layer's content; one detail names the layer. INTERNAL_ERROR: the object store failed; the request may be retried.

message.description: Human-readable explanation in English, for logs and notifications.

details.description: For VALIDATION_FAILED: what is wrong where. For LAYER_LOCKED (data model 1.3.0): one item, whose problem names the locked layer and whose path is /data/layerId when the request carries that layer's id there, else empty. path is a JSON Pointer into the change request.
